name: Rune Strike
castingTrigger: which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Runic power surges into the target you just struck, dealing it an extra 2d8 Necrotic damage. If the target is a Celestial, that damage increases by 1d8.
eli5: Right after a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, deal an extra 2d8 necrotic damage, or 3d8 if the target is a Celestial.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Death Grip
description: Runic energy lashes out to bind an enemy to you. Choose one creature you can see within range. Unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw, it is pulled in a straight line toward you, ending in the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of you.
eli5: Yank a creature you can see within 30 feet straight to a space next to you unless it passes a Strength save.

name: Vampiric Blood
description: Until the spell ends, your Hit Point maximum is 10 higher. Also, each time you regain Hit Points while it lasts, you regain an additional 1d6 Hit Points.
eli5: For up to 1 minute, raise your Hit Point maximum by 10 and regain an extra 1d6 Hit Points whenever you are healed.
higherLevelSlot: The additional healing increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Chains of Ice
description: Chains of ice wrap around one creature you can see within range, and it makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 1d10 Cold damage and its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.
eli5: Wrap a creature within 30 feet in ice chains for 1d10 cold damage and half Speed until the end of its next turn on a failed Dexterity save, or half damage on a success.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Scourge Strike
castingTrigger: which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Your attack deals an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage to the target, which must also succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition until the spell ends. While Poisoned this way, the target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, and a success ends the spell on it.
eli5: Right after a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, deal an extra 2d6 necrotic damage and poison the target until it passes a Constitution save at the end of one of its turns.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Death and Decay
description: Choose a point on the ground you can see within range. Corruption spreads from it in a 20-foot-radius Sphere, and each creature in that area makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and is cursed until the end of your next turn. Whenever you deal damage to a cursed creature with an attack roll, it takes an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
eli5: Corrupt a 20-foot-radius area within 60 feet for 2d6 necrotic damage and a curse that adds 1d6 necrotic to your attack hits on failed Wisdom saves, or half damage on a success.

name: Frostscythe
description: You sweep your weapon in front of you and release a wave of icy cold. Each creature in a 20-foot Cone makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 3d8 Cold damage and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
eli5: Sweep a 20-foot cone of frost for 3d8 cold damage and 10 feet less Speed for 1 minute on a failed Constitution save, or half damage on a success.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Leeching Strike
castingTrigger: which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Your strike drains life from the target you hit, which takes an extra 3d8 Necrotic damage from the attack, and you regain 3d4 Hit Points.
eli5: Right after a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, deal an extra 3d8 necrotic damage and regain 3d4 Hit Points.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d8, and the Hit Points you regain increase by 1d4, for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Remorseless Winter
description: You pull the warmth out of the creatures around you. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 6d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Regardless of the save's result, clinging frost reduces each of those creatures' Speed to 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
eli5: Chosen creatures within 30 feet of you take 6d6 cold damage, or half on a Constitution save, and all of them have Speed 10 feet until the end of their next turn.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Bonestorm
description: A whirlwind of battering bone and gore spins up around you. You regain 4d6 Hit Points, and each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
eli5: Regain 4d6 Hit Points while each creature within 10 feet of you takes 4d8 necrotic damage, or half on a Constitution save.

name: Throw Glaive
description: You conjure a demonic warglaive and throw it at a creature or object within range, making a ranged spell attack against it. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Slashing damage plus 1d8 Fire damage, and the glaive bounces to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the first one. Roll a new attack and new damage against that second target.
eli5: Throw a demonic glaive within 60 feet for 1d8 slashing plus 1d8 fire damage on a ranged spell attack hit, and on a hit it bounces to another target within 30 feet.
higherLevelSlot: The Fire damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1. The glaive can ricochet a maximum number of times equal to the level of the slot expended, and a creature can be targeted only once by each casting of this spell.

name: Consume Soul
description: You pull the essence out of a creature within range, and it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 4d4 Force damage, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half the Force damage it took. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.
eli5: Drain a creature within 60 feet for 4d4 force damage and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half of it on a failed Constitution save, or deal half damage on a success.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Fel Rush
description:
Fiery fel magic wraps around you and gives you explosive speed. Until the end of your turn, your Speed is 30 feet higher and your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

Whenever you move within 5 feet of a creature, or of an object that isn't being worn or carried, it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Each creature or object can take this damage only once per turn.
eli5: Gain 30 feet of Speed this turn without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and anything you move within 5 feet of takes 2d6 fire damage, or half on a Dexterity save.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Infernal Strike
description: You leap through the air, without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and land in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you then makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 Fire damage and has Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone other than you until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.
eli5: Leap up to 30 feet, then creatures within 10 feet of you take 2d6 fire damage and Disadvantage on attacks against others until your next turn, or half damage on a Dexterity save.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Sigil of Flame
description: You trace a sigil in the air, and it appears on a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d8 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Whatever the result, the target gives off heat in a 10-foot Emanation originating from itself until the end of its next turn. When the target's next turn starts, the target and every creature in the Emanation must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 Fire damage.
eli5: Brand a creature within 90 feet for 2d8 fire damage, or half on a Constitution save, then at the start of its next turn it and creatures within 10 feet of it risk 1d8 more.
higherLevelSlot: Both the initial and the later damage increase by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Eye Beam
description: You gather your magic in your eyes. When you cast the spell, and again as a Magic action on each of your later turns while it lasts, you can release a burst of fel magic. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
eli5: On casting and as a Magic action each later turn for up to 1 minute, fire a 15-foot cone of fel magic for 3d6 force damage, or half on a Dexterity save.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Fiery Brand
description:
You sear a fiery demonic symbol onto a creature within range, and it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d10 Fire damage and is cursed. As long as the curse lasts, you have Resistance to all damage that creature deals. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

At the end of each of its turns, a cursed creature repeats the save, and on a success the spell ends.
eli5: Brand a creature within 30 feet for 3d10 fire damage and gain Resistance to its damage until it passes a Wisdom save, or deal half damage if it saves at first.

name: Metamorphosis
material: one soul fragment, which the spell consumes
description:
Speaking an incantation, you call on fel or Void magic and transform, taking on demonic features. Until the spell ends, you gain one of the following benefits of your choice.

Devourer. Whenever you roll damage for a spell, weapon, or feature that deals Force damage, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3.

Havoc. Each time you hit a creature with an attack roll using a Melee weapon, that target takes an extra 1d6 Fire damage.

Vengeance. You gain a +2 bonus to AC, and both your Hit Point maximum and your current Hit Points increase by 5 for the spell's duration.
eli5: Take demonic form for 1 minute and pick one boost: force damage dice of 1 or 2 count as 3, melee weapon hits add 1d6 fire, or +2 AC and 5 more Hit Points.

name: Soul Reap
description: You tear an opening in reality and send a bolt of cosmic matter at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against it, and the target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover. On a hit, it takes 6d6 Force damage. Whenever you roll a 6 on a d6 for this spell, you can roll one more d6 and add it to the damage. The most of these extra d6s you can add to the spell's damage in one casting equals your spellcasting ability modifier.
eli5: Make a ranged spell attack within 60 feet that ignores Half and Three-Quarters Cover for 6d6 force damage, and each 6 rolled adds another d6, up to your spellcasting modifier.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Demon Spikes
description: Fel power surges through you, and hard, jagged spikes burst from your body. For the duration, you have a +2 bonus to AC, and whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, that creature takes 10 Piercing damage.
eli5: For 1 minute, gain +2 AC, and any creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee attack takes 10 piercing damage.

name: Chaos Nova
description: Chaos energy erupts from you in a 20-foot Emanation. Each creature of your choice in the Emanation takes 2d6 Force damage, and it must also succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn.
eli5: Chosen creatures within 20 feet of you take 2d6 force damage and are Stunned until the end of your next turn unless they pass a Wisdom save.

name: Collapsing Star
description: You pour Void energy into a devastating blast that fills a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you can see within range. Each creature of your choice in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d12 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
eli5: Blast a 20-foot-radius area within 60 feet so chosen creatures take 4d12 force damage, or half on a Constitution save.

name: Sigil of Chains
description: A sigil forms at a point on the ground you can see within range and then bursts outward in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5d6 Force damage, is pulled up to 10 feet straight toward the sigil, and has the Restrained condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
eli5: A sigil within 90 feet bursts 20 feet wide for 5d6 force damage, a 10-foot pull and Restrained on a failed Dexterity save, or half damage and 10 feet less Speed on a success.

name: Wrath
description: You fling a ball of energy at one target within range, making a ranged spell attack against it. If the attack hits, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage and its Speed drops by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
eli5: Make a ranged spell attack that deals 1d8 lightning damage and cuts the target's Speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
cantripUpgrade: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Moonfire
description: Lunar light lances down onto a creature you can see within range, and the target makes a Dexterity saving throw. If it fails, it takes 2d8 Radiant damage, sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius, and can't benefit from the Invisible condition until the end of its next turn. When that next turn ends, it takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage and the spell ends. If it succeeds, it takes only half the initial damage.
eli5: Burn a creature with moonlight for 2d8 radiant damage that reveals it if Invisible, plus 1d8 more at the end of its next turn, or just half the first hit on a Dexterity save.
higherLevelSlot: Both the initial and the later damage increase by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Feral Prowl
description: You shape-shift as though you had used Wild Shape, without spending a use of Wild Shape. Until the spell ends, you have the Invisible condition. The spell ends early right after you make an attack roll, deal damage, cast a spell, or return to your natural form.
eli5: Shape-shift like Wild Shape without spending a use and stay Invisible for up to 1 minute, until you attack, deal damage, cast a spell or change back.

name: Roar of Ursoc
description: You shape-shift as though you had used Wild Shape, without spending a use of Wild Shape. Until the start of your next turn, a creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of you has Disadvantage on attack rolls against any creature except you.
eli5: Shape-shift like Wild Shape without spending a use, and until your next turn, creatures starting their turn within 5 feet of you have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you.

name: Regrowth
description: A creature you can see within range regains 3d8 Hit Points. While the spell lasts, the target also regains 1d8 Hit Points at the start of each of your turns. The spell ends early as soon as it has restored 24 or more Hit Points.
eli5: Heal a creature you can see for 3d8 hit points, then 1d8 more at the start of each of your turns, until the spell has healed 24 hit points in total.

name: Starfall
description:
Falling stars crash down on a 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder within range. Each creature in the Cylinder makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d8 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Until the start of your next turn, a creature that enters the Cylinder for the first time on a turn or ends its turn inside it takes Radiant damage equal to your Druid level. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
eli5: Rain stars on a 30-foot-radius cylinder for 7d8 radiant damage, or half on a Dexterity save, and anyone entering or ending a turn there before your next turn takes your Druid level in damage.

name: Innervate
description:
One creature you choose within range gains a level 4 spell slot, which it can use to cast any spell it has prepared. The slot disappears once it is expended or when the target finishes a Long Rest.

You also regain one expended use of Wild Shape.
eli5: Give a creature within 30 feet a level 4 spell slot that lasts until used or a Long Rest, and regain one use of Wild Shape yourself.

name: Tranquility
description: For the duration, the power of nature surrounds you in a 60-foot Emanation. Creatures of your choice in the Emanation have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. As a Bonus Action, you can make each ally in the Emanation regain Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
eli5: Creatures you choose within 60 feet resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and as a Bonus Action you can heal each ally there for 2d8 plus your spellcasting modifier.
higherLevelSlot: Creatures regain 1d8 additional Hit Points for each spell slot level above 6.

name: Tree of Life
description:
You shape-shift into a treant-like Tree of Life form, which gives you the benefits below.

Tree Form. You become Large. Your Speed becomes 10 feet and can't be reduced, and moving through Difficult Terrain costs you no extra movement.

Bark Skin. You gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class and 10 Temporary Hit Points.

Condition Immunity. You have Immunity to the Paralyzed and Restrained conditions, and you can't be shape-shifted against your will.

Source of Life. Whenever a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains an extra 1d8 Hit Points on the turn you cast it.

Spells Enhanced. Your Druid spells have their spell save DC increased by 1, and you have Advantage on attack rolls for Druid spells you cast.
eli5: Become a Large tree for 1 minute with +2 AC, 10 temporary hit points, extra 1d8 healing on slot spells, and +1 DC and Advantage on attacks for your Druid spells.

name: Consecration
description: Holy light hallows the ground in a 15-foot Emanation around you for the duration. When you cast the spell, pick any number of creatures; each of them that starts its turn inside the Emanation takes 1d8 Radiant damage. Fiends and Undead treat the area as Difficult Terrain.
eli5: Hallow the ground within 15 feet of you so creatures you pick take 1d8 radiant damage when they start their turn there, and Fiends and Undead treat it as Difficult Terrain.

name: Guided Prayer
castingTrigger: which you take when you become Bloodied or when you take damage while Bloodied
description: You call on the Light in your moment of need. You regain Hit Points equal to 8d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and you have Advantage on the next attack roll you make before the end of your next turn.
eli5: As a reaction when you become Bloodied or are hurt while Bloodied, heal yourself for 8d4 plus your spellcasting modifier and gain Advantage on your next attack roll.

name: Divine Shield
castingTrigger: which you take when you take damage
description: A shell of radiant light closes around you until the start of your next turn. Until then you have Immunity to all damage, including the damage that triggered this spell. Your Speed can't be reduced, any reductions already affecting you are suspended, and nothing can move you against your will.
eli5: As a reaction when you take damage, become immune to all damage, including the triggering hit, and you cannot be slowed or moved against your will until your next turn.

name: Curse of Agony
description: You lay a festering curse on one creature within range. The curse's damage starts at 1d4 Psychic. The target makes a Constitution saving throw at once and again at the end of each of its turns while the spell lasts. On a failed save, it takes the damage and the die grows one size, from d4 to d6, d8, d10 and at most d12. On a successful save, it takes the damage at its current size and the spell ends.
eli5: Curse a creature to take 1d4 psychic damage now and at the end of each of its turns, growing one die size up to d12 on each failed Constitution save and ending on a success.

name: Hand of Gul'dan
description:
A demonic meteor streaks from you to a point you choose within range and bursts. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 Fire damage plus 2d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

For the duration, demonic spirits that look like fel imps dart around the Sphere. A creature that enters the Sphere or ends its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d8 Fire damage plus 1d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature can be affected by this spell only once per turn.
eli5: Drop a demonic meteor for 2d8 fire plus 2d8 necrotic damage in a 20-foot-radius sphere, and imps there deal 1d8 fire plus 1d8 necrotic, half on a Dexterity save each time.

name: Rain of Fire
description:
Hellfire pours down in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. While the spell lasts, you can take a Magic action on later turns to move the Cylinder up to 60 feet.

When the Cylinder appears, each creature inside it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d8 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes this save when the spell's area moves into its space and when it enters the spell's area or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

You have Advantage on spell attack rolls against a creature in the Cylinder, and if you hit, the target takes an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage.
eli5: Rain movable hellfire in a 20-foot-radius cylinder for 3d8 fire damage, or half on a Dexterity save, and your spell attacks on creatures inside get Advantage and 1d6 extra necrotic damage.
higherLevelSlot: The Fire damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Shadow Word: Pain
description:
You utter a word of Void power that wracks one creature in range with agony, and the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, it takes Psychic damage equal to 1d10 plus your spellcasting ability modifier and is cursed for the duration. If it succeeds, it takes only half as much damage.

While the curse lasts, the target takes 1d10 Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, and the curse ends on a success.
eli5: Deal 1d10 plus your spellcasting modifier psychic damage, or half on a Wisdom save, and a failed save curses the target to take 1d10 each turn until it saves.
higherLevelSlot: The spell's initial damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Prayer of Mending
description: You set a holy ward on one willing creature in range. When that creature next takes damage, the ward triggers and the creature regains Hit Points equal to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The ward then leaps to another ally of your choice within 30 feet of the warded creature and works the same way there. The spell ends if no ally is in range, and it also ends once the ward has healed five times.
eli5: Ward a willing creature so the next time it takes damage it heals 1d8 plus your spellcasting modifier, then the ward jumps to another ally within 30 feet, up to five heals.
higherLevelSlot: The spell can heal one additional time for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Holy Nova
description: Holy light explodes outward from you in a 30-foot Emanation, striking your enemies and mending your allies. Each creature of your choice in the Emanation makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d6 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Every other creature in the Emanation regains 3d6 Hit Points.
eli5: Burst holy light within 30 feet so creatures you choose take 5d6 radiant damage, or half on a Constitution save, and every other creature there heals 3d6 hit points.
higherLevelSlot: The damage and healing each increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Psychic Horror
description: Visions of the Void flood the mind of a creature within range, and it makes a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, it takes 2d10 Psychic damage and has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. A Frightened creature also has the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If it succeeds on the initial save, it takes only half as much damage.
eli5: Deal 2d10 psychic damage to a creature, which on a failed Wisdom save is also Frightened for 1 minute and Stunned until the end of your next turn, or takes half damage on a success.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Void Eruption
description:
Void energy bursts out in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. At the same moment, you assume a Void form that grants you the benefits below for the duration.

Void Bolt. As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can throw a bolt of Void energy at a creature within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes Necrotic damage equal to 2d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Void Stealth. You have the Invisible condition while you are in an area of Dim Light or Darkness.
eli5: Blast a 20-foot-radius sphere for 5d6 necrotic damage, or half on a Constitution save, then fire 2d6 plus modifier Void Bolts as a Bonus Action and turn Invisible in dim light or darkness.

name: Apotheosis
description:
You take on a spectral, angelic form that gives you the benefits below.

Angelic Wings. You have a Fly Speed of 90 feet.

Spectral Form. You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Radiant, and Slashing damage.

Holy Empowerment. Whenever you cast a spell with a spell slot and that spell restores Hit Points to one or more creatures or deals Radiant damage, work out the spell's effects as though you had used a spell slot 2 levels higher than the one you actually used (up to level 9).
eli5: Become an angel for 1 minute with a 90-foot Fly Speed, resistance to four damage types, and healing or radiant slot spells that act as if cast 2 levels higher, up to level 9.

name: Azure Strike
description: Rays of arcane frost streak toward up to two targets within range, and those targets must be within 30 feet of each other. You make a separate ranged spell attack against each target. A target that is hit takes 2d6 Force damage, and its Speed drops by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
eli5: Fire frosty rays at up to two targets within 30 feet of each other, each a ranged spell attack for 2d6 force damage that also cuts its Speed by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Ebon Might
description: You call on the black dragonflight, and draconic might bursts out of you. Any creatures you choose in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you become empowered until the end of your next turn. While empowered, a creature that hits a target with an attack roll deals an extra 1d4 Force damage with that attack.
eli5: Empower creatures you choose within 10 feet of you so their attack hits deal an extra 1d4 force damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Living Flame
description:
You send flickering flames toward a creature of your choice within range. Pick one of the following options.

Healing Flames. The target regains 2d6 Hit Points.

Searing Flames. You make a ranged attack roll against the target. If it hits, the target takes 2d8 Fire damage.
eli5: Throw flames at a creature within 60 feet that either heal it for 2d6 Hit Points or, on a ranged attack hit, burn it for 2d8 fire damage.
higherLevelSlot: You can choose one additional target for every two spell slot levels above 1 (two targets with a level 3 or 4 slot, three with a level 5 or 6 slot, four with a level 7 or 8 slot, and five with a level 9 slot). You pick the flames' effect separately for each target.

name: Dream Breath
description: You breathe out a wave of verdant healing magic. Any creatures you choose in a 15-foot Cone regain 2d6 Hit Points.
eli5: Breathe healing magic in a 15-foot cone so each creature you choose there regains 2d6 Hit Points.
higherLevelSlot: The healing increases by 2d6 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Eruption
description:
Flames burst up from the ground in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d8 Fire damage, and on a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

The ground in the Sphere is cracked and becomes Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn, when the cracks close.
eli5: Make the ground erupt in a 20-foot radius for 3d8 fire damage, or half on a Dexterity save, leaving it Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.
higherLevelSlot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Blistering Scales
description: You pick a willing creature you can see within range, and five explosive scales grow on it. For the duration, the target has a +1 bonus to AC. Whenever a creature hits the target with a melee attack roll before the spell ends, one scale explodes and the attacker takes 1d8 Fire damage. The spell ends early once the target has no explosive scales left.
eli5: Give a willing creature five exploding scales and +1 AC, and each melee hit against it pops a scale that deals 1d8 fire damage to the attacker.
higherLevelSlot: The target gains one more explosive scale for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Emerald Blossom
description:
A spectral bulb springs up from the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within range, and it remains for the duration.

At the end of each of your turns, the bulb releases healing magic in a 10-foot Emanation, and any allies you choose in the Emanation regain 5 Hit Points. Once the bulb has restored 20 Hit Points in total, it vanishes.
eli5: Grow a healing bulb that restores 5 Hit Points to allies you choose within 10 feet of it at the end of each of your turns, until it has healed 20 in total.
higherLevelSlot: The total Hit Points the bulb can restore increases by 5 for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Upheaval
description:
Burning stones burst upward to fill a 20-foot-radius, 10-foot-tall Cylinder originating from a point on the ground you can see within range. Each creature in the Cylinder makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d12 Bludgeoning damage plus 3d8 Fire damage and is thrown straight up to the top of the Cylinder, where it then falls. On a successful save, a creature takes only half as much damage.

The ground in the Cylinder is covered with smoldering stones and becomes Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.
